content.title: Jana - Baby Name Meaning, Origin and Popularity
content.text: Meaning:God is gracious; Showed favorJana is a feminine title from the Hebrew name Yehochanan meaning “God is gracious.” This elegant, two-syllable name is the female equivalent of John as well as the Hebrew name Hannah, which means “showed favor.” In Roman mythology, Jana is an ancient moon goddess and the wife of Janus. Some scholars have speculated that Janus and Jana were worshipped as Apollo and Diana, the sun and moon deities. Jana has the same eloquence as Jane while maintaining a unique and ethereal aura. Whether you wish to call on the moon's powerful energy or celebrate your faith with baby, Jana is a lovely title steeped in beauty and grace.Famous People Named JanaWondering who else shares this name?
